BiblicalUsage: Servant, the form of the word for slave that Simeon uses when he asks the Lord to let His servant depart in peace, and the word for the unprofitable servant cast into outer darkness. The Greek text spells it as a form of the word for a bondservant, not as a separate word.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the servant who departs in peace and the servant cast out are separated by one thing: whether they trusted the Master who called them.
RelatedEvents: The Presentation of Jesus in the Temple
